content.text:
**Finding submitted: deviation on § 21.1 (LOL-CAP).**

- **Problem:** The cap sat at one month of Fees actually paid — below the fallback floor (12 months) and inside walk-away territory — and "without exception" nullified the Excluded Claims regime in § 21.3, pulling indemnities, confidentiality, data protection/security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement inside an illusory cap.
- **Cure (single surgical replace):** § 21.1 now reads "Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's aggregate liability shall not exceed the greater of Fees paid or payable in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000."
- **Already met (untouched):** mutuality of the cap (§ 21.1), mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages (§ 21.2), and Customer's payment obligations not being damages (§ 21.3) — so no additional language was added.
